$comment: GOLDEN FACTS read from the source document BY EYE, NOT from FinSight output.
The results as PRINTED IN A NEWSPAPER (Jansatta, page 5), scanned into the
filing. The page also carries OTHER COMPANIES' results -- India
Infrastructure Finance Company and Pluxee, in Hindi -- and unrelated public
notices. Every figure below belongs to C.E. Info Systems; any fact FinSight
attributes to this issuer from outside the top-left block is a wrong fact.
Unit: Rs. in LAKHS. The page's text layer is unmapped glyphs and was not
used. The 'Reserves ... as shown in the Balance Sheet of previous year' row
is excluded as ambiguous in period (as for Indian Bank).

Phase 22: every row carries 'metric', the canonical key its printed label names, decided by reading the label in its statement (null: the taxonomy has no key for the line); 'metric_alt' lists keys that name the same measure. The scorer checks the key, not only the printed label.

transcription.method: read by eye from 1.5-1.6x crops of the scanned newspaper page
